release_read.basis: Diluted EPS $0.62 vs $0.57 consensus (+9%), NIM 3.48% above the CFO's 3.44-3.45% launch point, PPNR +17% QoQ on lower expense and higher fees, loans +2.1% and NIB deposits up; offset by classified loans rising to $35.0M (1.63%) on one $14.1M CRE relationship and a swing to a $0.8M provision. Sized below the +5.3% Q2 margin-beat reaction because part of the beat is expense/one-off (FHLB dividend) and the classified jump is a talking point for the 11:30 ET call.

key_line.detail: 3.48% vs 3.38% in Q2, above the CFO's 3.44-3.45% launch point; cost of deposits 1.24% from 1.28%; NIB deposits 37.8% of total; CFO expects 'modest net interest margin expansion over time' with a low rising-rate deposit beta. Credit offset: classified loans $35.0M (1.63%) from $19.9M (0.95%) on one $14.1M owner-occupied CRE relationship (paying as agreed), non-accrual 0.45% from 0.40%, special mention down to $65.1M from $100.9M, net charge-offs $21K.

guidance.detail: No formal guidance. CFO language ('modest NIM expansion over time', low deposit beta in a rising-rate environment) matches or slightly improves on the Q2-call tone.

call.detail: The call is at 08:30 PT, which is 11:30 ET, two hours into the session. It is likely to be asked about the classified-loan jump and the NIM path after the September hike. Management's tone on the Q2 call was constructive, so the call is more likely to help than hurt, but it is the main event risk in the session.

public_reaction.summary: As of ~09:20 ET no analyst action, wire story or retail chatter on the Q3 print was found. Coverage is 3-5 analysts (DA Davidson Buy PT $34, Brean Neutral PT $33, Stephens Equal-Weight per the hunt). A thin name with no option chain, so the public read has barely started.

tape_read.note: The tape shows no pre-market prints at all (prints 0, reference null, stale_at_open true), so the market has not traded the release yet. Read 'undershoot' only in the sense that nothing of the frozen +3.0% release read is priced; the open is the first real price discovery and is unreliable in a thin name. Prev close 27.11, entry 27.28 (position at -0.6% vs prev close before the print). IWM +0.11%, SPY +0.29% pre-market: a neutral to mildly positive tape.

thesis_check.note: The thesis was a NIM above the launch point against a $0.57 consensus, and NIM 3.48% with EPS $0.62 confirms it. The rise in classified loans is the one offset the thesis did not carry. The departure of the head of retail banking (judges' i4) is not addressed in the release.

expected.open_lag_note: There is no pre-market move to hold, so p_open_lags is a coin flip and says only that the open is uncertain. This is a bmo print on a thin, uncovered name with nothing traded yet, so I expect the session to keep repricing toward the release read rather than fade, and the open is likely to land under the full +3%. The 11:30 ET call adds variance.

recommendation.limit_basis: 28.05 is about +3.5% over the 27.11 previous close from the tape. That sits just above my frozen release read of +3.0% and inside the historical median reaction of 3.75% used as the implied move. A thin opening auction or an upbeat call can spike the price through that level, and a sale there captures that. If the limit is not reached, the position goes at the close, which is the bmo session's natural horizon. There is no pre-market print to be on the wrong side of, so the limit is above every price traded since the release.
recommendation.reason: De cijfers bevestigen de long: winst per aandeel $0,62 tegen $0,57 verwacht, en de rentemarge (3,48%) is hoger dan het management in juli had beloofd. Er is nog niets voorbeurs gehandeld, dus de markt moet het nieuws nog verwerken, en bij een kleine bank gaat dat meestal de hele dag door. Zet daarom een verkooplimiet op $28,05 (ongeveer +3,5%). Wordt die niet geraakt, dan gaat de positie eruit bij de slotkoers. De conference call om 11:30 New Yorkse tijd is het belangrijkste risico; de grotere probleemleningen kunnen daar ter sprake komen.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als er voor 09:30 toch voorbeurshandel verschijnt ruim boven $28 (meer dan +4%), dan verkopen bij de opening; staat de koers voorbeurs onder de slotkoers van vrijdag, dan alleen tot 10:00 houden.
